copy.headline: Miller won't return as Astros' pitching coach in '27 (source)
copy.caption:
A longtime fixture on the Astros’ coaching staff will not be back next season under new manager Brad Ausmus. A source told MLB.com’s Brian McTaggart on Monday that Josh Miller will not return as Houston’s pitching coach next season.

The club has not confirmed the news.
